name: any-lsp
description: Language-agnostic definition and reference navigation for every file

anyLsp.serverPath.description: Path to the any-lsp executable. Leave empty to use the bundled executable or any-lsp on PATH.

anyLsp.maxResults.description: Maximum number of locations returned by any-lsp.

anyLsp.caseSensitive.description: Whether any-lsp searches with case-sensitive matching.

anyLsp.include.description: Optional ripgrep glob patterns to include in workspace searches.

anyLsp.exclude.description: Ripgrep glob patterns to exclude from workspace searches.
